While this work takes place, the walking route between these platforms will be closed. Please allow a little longer for your journey and follow the signs, which will direct you via an alternative walking route. Depending on your journey, this route may be via street level. To pay the correct fare, just touch out as you exit and touch back in again, as you re-enter.

ELIZABETH LINE: Monday 16, Tuesday 17, Wednesday 18 and Thursday 19 November, the 2217 Abbey Wood to Reading train will terminate at Maidenhead. Customers travelling to Twyford and Reading should change at Maidenhead to the 2338 GWR service to Twyford and Reading. At Maidenhead, connecting westbound GWR trains to Twyford and Reading use Platform 1. For step-free interchange from platform 3 to platform 1, please use the lift to the main entrance, and then continue at street level under the railway bridge and up Shoppenhangers Road to the car park. Please ask staff to open the gate to platform 1, and allow extra time for your journey. The 2317 Reading to Paddington train is revised to start at Maidenhead at 2333, a later GWR service operates at 2350 from Reading to Paddington calling at Twyford, Reading and Slough
